hypothesis: A detector candidate trained only on fresh procedural scenes that require joining fragmented numeric X-tick glyph components while rejecting adjacent axis/tick fragments may reduce this reviewable detector failure mode without changing recognition, calibration, or marker stages.
isolated_change: fresh procedural fragmented numeric X-tick family registration and case-identity preparation only
data_scope: No fixture archive, prior candidate weight, prior candidate tensor, private/article image, development corpus, sealed corpus, external dataset, or consumed candidate case identity is read or reused. Only fresh train cases may be rendered into a caller-selected E-project artifact output; development and future-public cases remain unrendered.

defect_contract.positive: A complete numeric X-tick label whose glyph components are separated by a deterministic one-pixel break or compression-like gap.
confusers: small marker-like dot outside the label bounds
defect_contract.required_candidate_behavior: Join only components with the same declared numeric label identity; keep each listed confuser negative.

training.gpu_requirement_for_any_future_optimizer: RX 6600 XT only; CPU training is prohibited
